description: source_attachments for the three Tyler records in scenario tyler-fluvanna-census (issue #4578, ut_research_iv3): the 1900 census entry, the 1880 census entry and the 1923 death certificate. None is attached to anyone in the bundles' tree (PJHQ-7RG has no sources), so all three come back unattached. The predicate matches any call naming a record persona ARK (1:1:), so a router that checks any of the three gets this answer. source_attachments is not a live tool, so without a fixture the router's attached-sources check would abort the run.
